Do Hyun David Park

Welcome to my page!

I am a full-time MPH student at the Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health, concentrating in Epidemiology and Biostatistics. My research interests lie at the intersection of preventive cardiology, pulmonary health, and data analysis. Particularly, I am interested in how social determinants of health, environmental exposures, and behavioral risk factors influence clinical outcomes across diverse populations. I am also interested in how emerging technologies, such as artificial intelligence, mobile health applications, and digital biomarkers, can be leveraged to enhance chronic disease management and preventive care delivery. Building on my clinical background, I aim to bridge the gap between individual patient care and population-level interventions, ultimately contributing to scalable, data-driven, and community-centered strategies that advance equitable health outcomes in cardiopulmonary medicine.

Education

Johns Hopkins University | Baltimore, MD

MPH in Epidemiology and Biostatistics | 2025 -

University of California, Los Angeles | Los Angeles, CA

B.S. in Molecular, Cellular, & Developmental Biology | September 2016 - September 2020

Research Experience

Lazazzera Lab | Microbiology, Immunology & Molecular Genetics UCLA Undergraduate Investigator | January 2018 - June 2020

Xing Lab | Molecular, Cellular & Developmental Biology UCLA Undergraduate Investigator | June 2017 - January 2018

Hobbies


You can find me either cooking or taking film photos! But I also like to stay activity by playing soccer or basketball!
